title: RushWallet Contest #30

prize.note: the escrow was funded 101,000,000 sats total: 100,000,000 sats on 2014-09-22 later returned to its own sender on 2015-03-25, and a separate 1,000,000 sats on 2015-04-24 that remains unspent; the 1,000,000 sats figure is the live prize

target_format: unknown passphrase string, hashed verbatim (no trim, no case folding, no salt), SHA-256 as the 32-byte private key, uncompressed public key, P2PKH

derivation.summary: private_key = SHA256(utf8(passphrase)) taken verbatim, uncompressed secp256k1 public key, address = base58check(0x00 || RIPEMD160(SHA256(pubkey)))
derivation.certified_against: passphrases publicly claimed by other solvers for sibling brainwallets #17 and #28 of the same contest, plus the contest host's own address

difficulty_note: the derivation is certified; about 95 million candidate passphrases across public wordlists have produced zero matches; the likely gate is a video source above the 720p footage currently available, not more computation

leads.title: a higher-fidelity copy of the original promotional video
the Quotes-500K corpus, not yet ingested
the uncovered tail of the song-lyrics corpus (about 4.7 million songs)

third_party_material: the promotional video and its re-uploads are third-party/platform hosted and not mirrored here; only short quoted transcriptions and archived-page links are included
